name: What permits are required for framing a small addition in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for framing a small addition in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For framing a small addition in Daly City, you will typically need a building permit. This permit ensures that the structural plans, including the framing, comply with local building codes and safety regulations specific to Daly City. Depending on the project's scope, additional permits for electrical, plumbing, or mechanical work might also be necessary if these systems are part of the new addition. We handle the permit application process to ensure all necessary approvals are secured before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing a small addition in Daly City generally requires a building permit to ensure compliance with local codes; additional permits may be needed for other systems.
